title: VIX Sufficient Statistic Test on TAIFEX TX1 — Cross-Market Replication of K1315
research_background: K1315 confirmed: US VIX is a sufficient statistic for SPY daily RV — Anti-QLIKE combination assigns HAR-VIX weight=1.0, HAR-ABS weight=0.0. K1316 tests cross-market replication: does US VIX dominate HAR-RV for Taiwan futures (TX1) RV prediction?

hypotheses.H1: HAR-VIX QLIKE < HAR-RV QLIKE on TX1, with DM-HLN |t| > 3
hypotheses.H0: VIX has no incremental predictive value over own past RV for TX1 RV

methodology.target: log(RV_{t+1}), via rv.shift(-1) on TX1 daily realized variance
har_vix_features: 2*log(vix_lag1.rolling(5).mean()) — weekly avg of VIX then squared
2*log(vix_lag1.rolling(22).mean()) — monthly avg of VIX then squared
methodology.lookahead_guard: rv_lag1 = rv.shift(1) BEFORE rolling; vix_lag1 = vix.shift(1) BEFORE rolling; target = rv.shift(-1) on RV column only; 70/30 chronological split, fit on IS only
methodology.dm_test: DM-HLN Harvey (1997) h=1, on QLIKE losses
methodology.pass_rule: |DM_HLN_t| > 3 AND HAR-VIX lower QLIKE AND bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0

data_sources.TX1: TAIFEX TX1 tick CSV from K1309 cache (_tx1_daily_pd_2017-2026.parquet), day session 08:45–13:45, 5-min realized variance
data_sources.alignment: Inner join on trading date (Taiwan vs US may differ on holidays)

qlike.interpretation_sign: positive => HAR-RV worse (higher QLIKE) => HAR-VIX preferred

mse.interpretation_sign: positive => HAR-RV worse (higher MSE) => HAR-VIX preferred

bootstrap.interpretation: positive diff => HAR-RV higher QLIKE => HAR-VIX preferred

qlike.interpretation_sign: positive => HAR-RV worse (higher QLIKE) => HAR-VIX preferred

mse.interpretation_sign: positive => HAR-RV worse (higher MSE) => HAR-VIX preferred

conclusions.primary: NULL: VIX is NOT a sufficient statistic for TX1 RV. HAR-VIX QLIKE=-8.653797 vs HAR-RV QLIKE=-6.155833 (+40.6%), DM-HLN t=1.041. K1315 result (VIX sufficient for SPY) does not generalize cross-market to Taiwan futures. Supports domestic RV persistence dominates foreign vol signal for TX1.
conclusions.k1315_comparison: K1315: HAR-VIX weight=1.0 for SPY (VIX sufficient for own-market RV). K1316: verdict=NULL for TX1 (cross-market test). Together these experiments characterize the VIX sufficient statistic hypothesis within-market vs cross-market.
conclusions.null_result_interpretation: NULL result is informative: domestic RV persistence (HAR-RV) is sufficient for TX1 volatility prediction; US fear gauge does not provide incremental information beyond own past RV.
